android.extraProguardRules:
# Only rules that R8 cannot infer belong here. React Native, expo-modules-core and
# Firebase all ship their own consumer keep rules inside their AARs, so repeating them
# here is not free: a package-wide `-keep ... { *; }` opts that whole package out of
# shrinking, optimization AND obfuscation at once. The scores Play Console reports measure
# how much of the codebase R8 is ALLOWED to touch, so every broad rule here lowers them
# directly.

# --- R8 global options ---
# Repackage every class into the root package: shorter names, smaller DEX. AGP 9.1 makes
# this the default; we are on AGP 8.11, so it has to be requested. `-allowaccessmodification`
# is already supplied by proguard-android-optimize.txt.
-repackageclasses ''

# --- fbjni hybrid objects ---
# C++ reaches these members by name through fbjni's HybridData, so R8 sees no reference to
# them. Mirrors ReactAndroid/src/main/java/com/facebook/hermes/reactexecutor/fbjni.pro,
# which React Native does NOT expose as a consumer rule.
-keepclassmembers class * {
    com.facebook.jni.HybridData *;
    <init>(com.facebook.jni.HybridData);
}
-keepclasseswithmembers class * {
    com.facebook.jni.HybridData *;
}

# --- Hermes ---
# Loaded from C++ by class descriptor, so the NAME must survive. Members are already
# covered by React Native's @DoNotStrip consumer rules, and `-keepnames` still lets R8
# optimize the bodies.
-keepnames class com.facebook.hermes.reactexecutor.HermesExecutor
-keepnames class com.facebook.hermes.reactexecutor.HermesExecutorFactory

# --- Kotlin reflection metadata ---
# expo-modules-core reads @kotlin.Metadata to build Record and Enumerable types; R8 full
# mode strips annotations that are not explicitly kept. One class, no size impact.
-keep class kotlin.Metadata { *; }

# --- Warning suppression (no effect on shrinking or optimization) ---
-dontwarn okhttp3.**
-dontwarn javax.annotation.**
-dontwarn com.google.firebase.**
